title: Finding Is Not Returning, Returning Is Not Reconstructing: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of Agent Social Re-entry
title_zh: 发现不等于返回，返回不等于重构：智能体社交再入的多维度评估

paragraphs.en: 提出社交再入评估框架，区分发现、返回与重构三能力，发现记忆提升识别但不保证上下文重构。 As Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly participate in persistent social environments, understanding their long-term social interaction capabilities becomes increasingly important. While existing research has advanced long-term memory and conversational context retrieval, less attention has been paid to whether agents can autonomously re-engage with previously inactive conversations. In particular, remembering a past interaction does not necessarily mean that an agent can identify when to revisit it, decide to return, or reconstruct the context needed for a coherent continuation. To investigate this gap, we introduce agent social re-entry as a multi- dimensional evaluation problem, distinguishing three complementary capabilities: Finding, Returning, and Reconstructing. We develop a shared-snapshot evaluation framework that measures these dimensions independently, allowing us to examine how conversational resurfacing and persistent memory relate to different aspects of social re-entry. Evaluations across six LLM configurations show that resurfacing substantially improves target conversation identification, while persistent memory is associated with higher rates of autonomous target-directed replying. However, neither improvement is accompanied by consistent gains in contextual reconstruction. These results highlight the distinction between accessing previous conversations, choosing to re-engage, and maintaining conversational continuity. Our framework provides a way to evaluate these capabilities separately rather than relying on memory retrieval or conversational response quality alone.
paragraphs.zh: 提出社交再入评估框架，区分发现、返回与重构三能力，发现记忆提升识别但不保证上下文重构。随着大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益参与持久性的社交环境，理解其长期社交互动能力变得越来越重要。 虽然现有研究在长期记忆和对话上下文检索方面取得了进展，但智能体能否自主重新参与先前不活跃的对话却较少受到关注。 特别是，记住过去的交互并不一定意味着智能体能够识别何时应重新审视它、决定返回，或重构连贯延续所需的上下文。 为了探究这一空白，我们将智能体社交再入作为一个多维度评估问题提出，区分三种互补能力：发现、返回与重构。 我们开发了一个共享快照评估框架，独立测量这些维度，使我们能够考察对话重现和持久记忆与社交再入不同方面的关系。 在六种 LLM 配置上的评估表明，重现显著提升了目标对话识别，而持久记忆与更高的自主目标导向回复率相关。 然而，这两种提升都没有伴随上下文重构方面的持续改进。 这些结果凸显了访问先前对话、选择重新参与以及保持对话连续性之间的区别。 我们的框架提供了一种分别评估这些能力的方式，而不是仅依赖记忆检索或对话响应质量。
